classification.difficultyReason: Translate each supplied division into equal spans across the dividend interval, coordinating unit subdivisions with jumps that cross whole-number boundaries.

content.prompt: Use a number line to illustrate each of these divisions.

answer.short: Divide the interval from $0$ to $1$ into three equal lengths of $\frac13$.
answer.worked: Draw a number line from $0$ to $1$. Divide this interval into three equal parts, with endpoints $0$, $\frac13$, $\frac23$ and $1$. Label each part $\frac13$.

spec.description: Interval from zero to one partitioned into three equal labelled lengths.
spec.mathematics: Three intervals of length 1/3 together span 1.

answer.short: Divide the interval from $0$ to $3$ into two equal lengths of $1\frac12$.
answer.worked: Draw a number line from $0$ to $3$, marking the whole numbers. Divide the complete interval into two equal parts at $1\frac12$. Label each part $\frac32=1\frac12$.

spec.description: Whole-number ticks from zero to three and two equal labelled spans.
spec.mathematics: Two intervals of length 3/2 together span 3.

answer.short: Divide the interval from $0$ to $5$ into three equal lengths of $1\frac23$.
answer.worked: Draw a number line from $0$ to $5$, marking the whole numbers and dividing each unit into thirds. Mark the equal-division endpoints $0$, $1\frac23$, $3\frac13$ and $5$. Label each of the three spans $\frac53=1\frac23$.

spec.description: Interval from zero to five partitioned into three equal labelled spans; thirds support locating the division points.
spec.mathematics: Three intervals of length 5/3 together span 5.

answer.short: Divide the interval from $0$ to $7$ into four equal lengths of $1\frac34$.
answer.worked: Draw a number line from $0$ to $7$, marking the whole numbers and dividing each unit into quarters. Mark the equal-division endpoints $0$, $1\frac34$, $3\frac12$, $5\frac14$ and $7$. Label each of the four spans $\frac74=1\frac34$.

spec.description: Interval from zero to seven partitioned into four equal labelled spans; quarters support locating the division points.
spec.mathematics: Four intervals of length 7/4 together span 7.
